Hello! I love your art.

I was wondering if I could get a piece featuring a child Takasugi Shinsaku (Fate/Grand Order) with his first ascension hair and a young Amagi Rinne (Ensemble Stars!!) as a child in his Ainu-esque clothing? The crossover scenario could feature a small scene between them. For example, Rinne holding his hand out to sickly child Shinsaku who is sitting on the engawa, or maybe the two of them are running into the forest while holding hands. Ideally, Rinne is acting like an older brother to the frailer Shinsaku. I leave the aesthetics of the scenario in your hands.

Thank you for your consideration. Your Takasugi drawings are my favorite!
